Welcome to FinTrack! This app helps you track expenses, manage budgets, and analyze your financial health locally on your device.

1. Accounts: Set up your bank accounts, cash, and credit cards first.
2. Categories: Define where your money goes (Food, Rent, etc.).
3. Transactions: Use the '+' button to record daily spending or income.

• Asset: Anything you own that has value (Cash, Bank Balance).
• Liability: Money you owe (Credit Card debt, Loans).
• Networth: Your Total Assets minus Total Liabilities.
• Budget: A limit you set for spending in specific categories.

Go to \'Loan & Subscriptions\' to set up fixed-term loans. The app will automatically calculate the EMI (principal + interest) and remind you of due dates. You can enable \'Auto-Record\' to have installments deducted from your accounts automatically.

When creating an account, select \'Credit Card\' as the type. Input your credit limit and billing cycle. The app will alert you if your utilization exceeds 30%, helping you maintain a healthy credit score.

\u2022 Tags: Use tags for temporary events like \'Vacation\' or \'Project X\' to track cross-category spending.\n\u2022 Password Strength: Keep your master password as combination of alphabets, numbers, special characters, upper and lower case.\n\u2022 Backups: Regularly back up your database to your local storage and via WebDAV for safety.
Tip: If you want to track expenses under sub-categories, keep the category description in the format - Main: Minor.
Example - Food: Dining, Food: Snacks, Health: Medicines, Health: Consultation etc.
